item.title: Utah Valley University continues to deny request for documents in Charlie Kirk shooting
item.description: The assassination of Charlie Kirk left many with questions about campus security, but in the months since, the university has declined to release the security plan from that day.

item.title: Utah lawmakers debate bill to deny food aid to residents without valid ID
item.description: There was impassioned discussion Tuesday on Utah’s Capitol Hill about a proposed House Bill that would deny free and subsidized meals to those without a valid ID.

item.title: Utah Mammoth eye playoff spot after Olympic break, key players return
item.description: With Olympic hockey still underway in Milan, the Utah Mammoth players who are not competing overseas are back on home ice, focused on preparing for the final stretch of the NHL season.
